## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--journal-view` (branch `phase/journal-view`). Primary store is on `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow` — you do not write records. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`. Do not edit code to make checks pass; a failing check is recorded as fail and routed to execute (decision: verification executor does not edit).

Run only the verify_commands on the acceptances. Do not run the full suite unless an acceptance names it.

### Design Invariants

Only repair and evaluate efforts pay for journal loading on the main snapshot. Record text is shown as stored.

### Decisions

- journal-screen, journal-order, journal-types, kind-journal-panel, task-agent-work (phase decisions)
